title: VAT Category dropdown + country-based reduced VAT mapping + disclaimer/tooltip

requirements.summary: Add a VAT Category dropdown under VAT selection in the transaction step with the exact option labels and default to “Others”.
acceptanceCriteria: In the VAT calculator transaction step UI, a “VAT Category” dropdown is shown under VAT selection.
The dropdown options match the provided list exactly and are user-facing in English.
The default selection is “Others” for a new calculation.

file_operations.description: Add a new “VAT Category” Select control under the existing VAT selection area and render the options with the exact English labels provided in REQ-1; default the selection to “Others” when no prior value exists. Use the shadcn-ui Select and Label components already used in this file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Extend initial calculator form data to include the VAT Category field and set its default to “Others”, ensuring a new calculation starts with that selection.

requirements.summary: Persist VAT Category through the calculator flow so it is available for calculation and downstream steps (results/invoice/preview).
acceptanceCriteria: Changing VAT Category and moving forward/backward in the calculator preserves the selected category.
The selected VAT Category is included in the data passed from the transaction step to the calculation step (where VAT is computed).

file_operations.description: Extend VATCalculationInput types to include a VAT Category field (and export a suitable VatCategory type + label mapping) so the selection is part of the shared form state across transaction/results/invoice/preview.
Update the step’s local state and onNext payload to read/write the VAT Category value into the shared VATCalculationInput form state, so it persists when navigating between steps.
Ensure the form state merging logic (handleNext/back/new calculation) includes the VAT Category field so it remains available at calculation time and through results/invoice/preview.

requirements.summary: Implement country+VAT Category based computed VAT rate logic for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE only, including multiple reduced rates and standard fallback rules.
acceptanceCriteria: For DE: selecting any of the eligible categories results in 7%; all other categories (including Others) result in 19%.
For FR: eligible categories map to 10% or 5.5% as specified; all other categories (including Others) result in 20%.
For IT: eligible categories map to 10% / 5% / 4% as specified; all other categories (including Others) result in 22%.
For SE: eligible categories map to 12% / 6% as specified; all other categories (including Others) result in 25%.
For BE: eligible categories map to 12% / 6% as specified; all other categories (including Others) result in 21%.
When a category is not eligible, the app does not keep/force a reduced rate—VAT calculation uses the Standard rate (fallback).

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated helper module that computes the VAT rate percent from (selectedCountry, vatCategory) for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE only, including: (1) “Others” always returns standard, (2) categories not eligible return standard, and (3) multiple reduced rates for FR/IT/SE/BE are selected by category per the user-provided mapping.

Replace the current rate selection logic (standard vs reduced first reducedRates[0]) with the computed VAT rate percent from the new country+category helper for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE, while keeping existing behavior for other countries. Ensure the computed percent is passed into calculateEUVAT so the results step uses it.
Keep calculateEUVAT as the single VAT math function, but ensure it is called with the computed country+category rate percent so VATCalculationResult.vatRatePercent reflects the computed mapping.

requirements.summary: Update transaction step VAT UI to reflect the computed VAT rate for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE and prevent users from forcing an incorrect reduced/standard choice.
acceptanceCriteria: For DE/FR/IT/SE/BE, users cannot end up with a reduced VAT rate applied when their VAT Category is not eligible.
The VAT results shown correspond to the computed (country, category) rate, not an arbitrary user-selected reduced/standard toggle.

file_operations.description: Compute and display the final VAT rate percent derived from (countryCode, VAT Category) for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE within the VAT selection area (e.g., show a clear “Computed VAT Rate: X%” line). Ensure any existing VAT Rate selector (RadioGroup) is either hidden/disabled for those countries or constrained so it cannot produce an ineligible reduced rate. Use existing shadcn-ui RadioGroup/Badge/Alert patterns already present in the file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the calculation step always uses the computed country+category VAT rate for DE/FR/IT/SE/BE regardless of any lingering vatRate toggle state, so results cannot diverge from the rules.

requirements.summary: Render the provided legal disclaimer text under the VAT selection area in the transaction step.
acceptanceCriteria: The disclaimer text is rendered under VAT selection in the transaction step.
The text matches exactly (including punctuation and quotation marks are not required in UI, but the sentence must match verbatim).

file_operations.description: Add the exact disclaimer sentence under the VAT selection area (near VAT Category / VAT Rate controls): “Reduced VAT rates apply only to specific goods and services as defined under national VAT legislation. Users are responsible for verifying eligibility before applying reduced rates.” Ensure it is user-facing and in English.

requirements.summary: Add an info tooltip near VAT Category (or VAT selection section) with the exact helper text.
acceptanceCriteria: Hovering/focusing the info icon shows the tooltip text exactly as provided.
Tooltip appears in the transaction step near VAT Category / VAT selection.

file_operations.description: Place an info icon next to the “VAT Category” label (or in the VAT selection section header) and show a tooltip with the exact text: “Not sure which category applies? Select ‘Others’ to apply the standard VAT rate.” Use the existing shadcn-ui Tooltip components already imported/used in this file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
